keyVerseDR: "...a man's life doth not consist in the abundance of things which he possesseth." (Lk 12:15)

level1.title: Rich Toward God
level1.story: A man wanted Jesus to make his brother share money. Jesus told about a rich man who built bigger barns for his stuff. That night he died. Being rich toward God is what matters!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the rich man build?
level1.prayer: God, help me be rich in love. Amen.

activity.title: Mass bingo
activity.intro: God is better than stuff! Mark the words you hear at Mass.

level2.title: The Rich Fool
level2.story: A man in the crowd said, "Master, speak to my brother that he divide the inheritance with me." Jesus said, "Take heed and beware of all covetousness." He told of a rich man whose land produced plenty, who said, "I will pull down my barns, and will build greater." He planned to rest, eat, drink, and make merry. But God said, "Thou fool, this night do they require thy soul of thee," and so is he who is not rich towards God.
level2.keyLine: A man's life doth not consist in the abundance of things which he possesseth.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did God call the man a fool?
What does it mean to be rich toward God?
level2.prayer: Lord, make me rich toward You. Amen.

activity.title: A habit to drop
activity.intro: What 'stuff' takes my heart from God? Weigh it up.
activity.right: How I can be rich toward God
